# LoL Live Companion — Marketplace copy

**Search line:** A League of Legends Stream Deck companion showing live gold, health, mana, KDA, CS per minute, champion level and item-afford alerts from the local Live Client Data API.

**Tagline:** Your game, on your deck.

**What it is:** LoL Live Companion reads the League client's local Live Client Data API while you're in a match, so there's no API key and nothing leaves your PC. Buttons go idle out of game.

**Features:**
- Gold Tracker that flashes when your gold climbs.
- Health and resource: HP and mana on one key, or split onto separate HP and Mana keys. Handles manaless champions.
- Item Afford Alert: set a gold cost and the key glows green when you can buy it.
- KDA, champion Level, and CS with a live CS-per-minute rate.
- No setup, no key, fully local.
